name: pcbcad
description: Agent-driven, browser-based PCB + mechanical CAD and simulation for complete hardware products. Uses your locally installed agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) as the LLM provider.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pcbcad/server" "npm run dev -w @pcbcad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pcbcad/web && npm run build -w @pcbcad/server
